original.target_description: Original primary paper could not be acquired through the attempted open-access routes.

replication.target_description: Ten-country replication: main effect of discussion (non-discussed versus discussed critical questions) in repeated-measures final recognition accuracy ANOVA, with country between participants.

n.quote: Participants who were not exposed to co-witness details at all were excluded from the subsequent analyses.
n.sample_role: Participants contributing to the critical-item repeated-measures ANOVA after excluding those exposed to no co-witness details.
n.exclusions: One to thirteen participants per country excluded for no exposure to co-witness details. Exact combined analytic n is not explicitly printed in the examined text. Overall 486 is not substituted for this analytic n; the ANOVA reports error df 405 with ten countries.

reported_success.quote: thus replicating the original findings of Garry et al. (2008).

notes: Replication title verified against supplied reference; repository lists equivalent publication DOI 10.1016/j.jarmac.2018.09.004. Supplied p. 19 points near the relevant passage; selected requested printed partial eta squared for the discussion main effect on manuscript p. 18, rather than Hedges g meta-analysis on p. 19. Analytic n left null because not explicitly printed after critical-item exclusions; no n derived from degrees of freedom. Original DOI landing page and Researchmap primary PDF returned 403; OpenAlex had no OA location; author-site alternatives did not expose a downloadable paper. No original statistics imported from secondary quotations.
